required_fixes: Correct prereg/spec N compliance: spec.json measurement_validity #6 and prereg require N >= 480 paired samples (60 per condition x 8 co-occurring conditions); observed is N=240 (4 token_refresh+noise conditions x 60, phase_b_cooccurring). Reporting must state N=240, not 480, and cannot claim 8-condition coverage; replication at n>=480 required before claiming parent-comparable orthogonality power

Correct behavioral_score description: producer observations/report state bimodal ~0.48 (failure) vs ~0.65 (success) but raw_evidence shows only 0.35 vs 0.65 (verified: failure = 0.03 admin + 0.02 session_valid + 0.30 status401 = 0.35, success = 0.45 refreshed + 0.15 new_token + 0.03 + 0.02 = 0.65). Revise report/validity_notes to 0.35 and acknowledge both modes exceed 0.25 threshold by construction

Address measurement_validity #4 'continuous' violation: spec requires behavioral_score for token_refresh must be continuous, not fixed 0.65; delivered is discrete bimodal (two values) driven by Bernoulli mixture at p_refresh_success=0.7, not continuous severity variation. Either revise spec to accept binary variance or implement graded severity

Resolve TOST orthogonality overstatement: producer correctly reports tost_pass=false, ci=[-0.185439,0.066922], tost_p_lower=0.080972 >0.05, tost_p_upper=0.000567 <0.05. Full equivalence at delta=0.15 requires BOTH tails (prereg: CI upper bound <0.15 is necessary but not sufficient; spec says orthogonality tested via TOST equivalence). Lower-tail failure at n=240 means orthogonality not demonstrated at prereg delta on this sample. Must report as 'upper-tail only' and replicate at n>=480 before claiming delta=0.15 equivalence

Acknowledge threshold tautology for C2: THRESHOLD=0.25 is below both bimodal modes (0.35 and 0.65) so TP=1.0 is guaranteed regardless of noise; even 30% failure rate cannot fail detection. Strengthen test with threshold sensitivity analysis or calibrated threshold before claiming robustness to noise is discriminating

Fix artifact hash error: result.json artifacts freeze.json sha256 is placeholder 1c5e3e0f4b5b5b... vs actual 2c42c025a1ea12651d8a0f44477f9e4040c22f74c26f40b95faa5c30264277dd; correct provenance to actual hash

validity_findings.finding: N=240 violates frozen N>=480 (spec measurement_validity bullet 6, prereg). Spec promised 8 co-occurring conditions (60x8) matching parent EXP-PRODUCT-35445596342 (2 drifts x 4 noises). This experiment tests only token_refresh x 4 noises = 4 conditions (240). Power for TOST is halved; observed CI width 0.252 ([-0.185,0.067]) vs parent n=480 CI width ~0.12. Lower-tail failure is a direct power consequence, not a mechanism difference.

Behavioral score is bimodal discrete (0.35,0.65) not continuous; variance std 0.128-0.143 is Bernoulli variance (p=0.7) not continuous severity. Report/observations misstate failure mode as 0.48. Continuity requirement explicitly in spec measurement_validity [3]. Raw shows exactly two values across 240+60 samples.

Detection threshold 0.25 below both behavioral modes makes TP=1.0 tautological. No noise condition can suppress score below threshold because even refresh failure (0.35) exceeds threshold by 0.10. C2 TP>=0.85 survives by construction, not by demonstrated resistance to structural noise. Parent permission_boundary (0.32-0.545) straddled threshold; token_refresh does not, so noise robustness claim is weaker.

validity_findings.finding: Orthogonality TOST fails overall (tost_pass=false). Upper tail passes (p_upper 0.000567 <0.05, ci_upper 0.066922 <0.15) but lower tail fails (p_lower 0.080972 >0.05, ci_lower -0.185 < -0.15). Producer correctly discloses this and redefines C3 as variance-only per frozen decision_rule (spec.json:decision_rule C3 = behavioral_std >0.05). However measurement_validity #5 requires TOST delta=0.15 equivalence; full equivalence not met. Producer's claim_ceiling implies orthogonality confirmed, but only upper bound is confirmed at n=240.
